name: La Recta Provincia
summary: A shadowy brotherhood of indigenous Huilliche and mestizo sorcerers (brujos) that operated as an underground legal system on the remote island of Chiloé.
lore: La Recta Provincia functioned like a shadowy government. According to trial documents from 1880, its leaders gathered in a hidden underground chamber called the Cueva de Quicaví. Legend says the cave was guarded by the Imbunche—a stolen child transformed through dark magic into a twisted, deformed beast. The order used magical grimoires (revisorios), communicated via glowing nocturnal signals, and levied taxes or 'protection insurance' on locals until the Chilean state brought them to trial.

events.title: The Imbunche Stirs
events.narrative: The guardian of the Cueva de Quicaví grows restless in its chains. The elders say it has not been fed in a season and is beginning to whisper the old names again.

choiceB.label: Let it loose on a rival village

events.title: The Ancud Tide-Callers Rise
events.narrative: The coastal brujos of Ancud have been turning the fog against your boats, choking the northern trade route. They claim the strait belongs to them now.

choiceA.label: Break their fog with a counter-rite

choiceB.label: Send converts to undermine them from within

events.title: The Stilt-Witches of Castro
events.narrative: The witches of Castro's palafitos have woven a curse into the wooden pilings of the waterfront. Three houses lean at impossible angles, and no carpenter will touch them.

choiceA.label: Unweave the curse with fennel smoke

choiceB.label: Buy the cursed houses for cheap

events.title: The Deep Ones of Quellón
events.narrative: Fishers at the island's southern tip refuse to cast nets. They say the Deep Ones beneath the waves have woken and are calling souls down to the black water.

choiceA.label: Sail out and parley with the Deep

events.title: The Glowing Signals
events.narrative: Strange lights pulse from the hills above Quicaví at midnight — not your own. Someone else is using the old signal system, and they are not of your order.

choiceA.label: Trace the signals to their source
choiceA.description: +100 Faith if found, −5 Followers if lost

random.winMessage: You catch a lone brujo trying to usurp the signal network. He swears loyalty rather than face the Imbunche. +100 Faith.
random.lossMessage: The lights vanish before you reach them. Word spreads that your order has lost its grip on the old ways. −5 Followers.

choiceB.label: Ignore them and strengthen your own signals

events.title: The Stolen Grimoire
events.narrative: A revisorio — one of the order's magical grimoires — has gone missing from the Cueva. The elders are furious. They suspect a rival sect on the mainland.

choiceA.label: Hunt the thief across the archipelago

choiceB.label: Copy a new grimoire from memory

events.title: A Village Refuses the Tax
events.narrative: A settlement on the eastern shore declares it will no longer pay the 'protection insurance.' They say the mainland courts will protect them now.

choiceA.label: Make an example of their headman

choiceB.label: Offer them a year of grace

events.title: A Traveler from the Mainland
events.narrative: A gaunt stranger arrives on the island ferry, eyes wide with desperation. 'I walked south for forty days to find the Recta Provincia. I seek only purpose.'

events.title: The Volcano Speaks
events.narrative: A distant volcano across the inland sea rumbles and sends a pillar of ash. The elders argue over whether it is an omen of ruin or of power.

choiceA.label: Prophesy it as a sign of ascendance

choiceB.label: Perform a blood rite to absorb its power

events.title: The State Comes Asking
events.narrative: A Chilean official arrives in Castro with questions about 'the old brotherhood.' He is polite, but his notebook is thick, and he has a list of names.

choiceB.label: Discredit him with a curse
choiceB.description: +100 Faith if it works, −5 Followers if it fails

random.winMessage: The official falls ill and flees the island. Your followers marvel at your reach. +100 Faith.
random.lossMessage: The curse rebounds. Five followers, named in his book, flee the island in fear. −5 Followers.
